FINDING 1 -- BLOCKING FOR MERGE, BUT NOT THIS PR'S DEFECT, AND NOT FIXABLE BY ANY REVIEWER. A stale review record is an unconditional hard FAIL, not merely an uncounted one. scripts/lwb_lanes.independent_reviews calls _review_ok on EVERY *.json in reviews/<pr>/ and _review_ok appends its STALE error to `errors` regardless of how many fresh AGREE records exist alongside it. Measured, twice, on this branch: (i) adding a fresh AGREE as a NEW file (reviews/51/zz-sim.json, naming 07f82d1) leaves lwb_lanes.py exiting 1 with both pre-existing records still reported STALE; (ii) refreshing this file in place, so only reviewer A's reviews/51/cloud-reviewer-clock-016Yb3Nh.json remains stale, still exits 1 on that one record. CONSEQUENCE: this PR CANNOT go green on my record alone. Someone with write scope over the whole reviews/51/ directory -- the author, not a reviewer -- must delete or refresh reviews/51/cloud-reviewer-clock-016Yb3Nh.json (it names cea5a1b). I did not touch it: my authorisation is to write exactly one file, and deleting another reviewer's record is not mine to do. This is also why I overwrote the previous B record instead of adding cloud-reviewer-b-<my-token>.json -- a per-run filename would have left a second unclearable FAIL behind. The same mechanism is why PR #45 is red right now (its only failing step is lwb-lanes, on two records naming 073034f0), and it is very likely the engine behind the repeated 're-cut to drop stale records' PRs. Worth a follow-up item on lwb_lanes.py -- treat a stale record as not-counting rather than as an error, or make the message say which party can clear it -- not a change to this PR.
